title: English publications: Taiwan Epidemiology Bulletin and Annual Report
summary: English-language publications from Taiwan CDC: the Taiwan Epidemiology Bulletin, the Taiwan CDC Annual Report, the annual statistics report and open data.
bodyMarkdown:
Taiwan CDC publishes key surveillance results and program reports in English.

- **Taiwan Epidemiology Bulletin** — peer-reviewed reports on outbreak investigations, surveillance and program evaluation; latest issue: [Vol. 42, No. 18](/publications/bulletin-42-18/).
- **Taiwan CDC Annual Report** — the year's disease control programs and achievements; [2025 edition](/publications/annual-report-2025/).
- **Statistics of Communicable Diseases and Surveillance Report** — [annual statistics](/publications/statistics-annual-2025/).
- **Open data** — notifiable disease statistics as [open datasets](/data/).

All publications list their owner, review date and licence (Open Government Data License, version 1.0).

zh-TW.title: 英文出版品：疫情報導與年報
zh-TW.summary: 疾管署英文出版品：疫情報導（Taiwan Epidemiology Bulletin）、疾病管制署年報、傳染病統計暨監視年報與開放資料。
zh-TW.bodyMarkdown:
疾管署以英文發布重要監測結果與計畫報告。

- **疫情報導（Taiwan Epidemiology Bulletin）**：疫情調查、監測與計畫評估之同儕審查報告；最新一期：[第 42 卷第 18 期](/publications/bulletin-42-18/)。
- **疾病管制署年報（Taiwan CDC Annual Report）**：年度防疫計畫與成果；[2025 年版](/publications/annual-report-2025/)。
- **傳染病統計暨監視年報**：[年度統計](/publications/statistics-annual-2025/)。
- **開放資料**：法定傳染病統計[開放資料集](/data/)。

所有出版品均標示權責單位、審閱日與授權（政府資料開放授權條款第 1 版）。
